raw.description: 对手pp值总和每比自身高1倍，自身造成的攻击伤害提升30%|回合开始时，若自身存在pp值相等的技能则当回合自身技能命中后恢复所有技能1点pp并吸取对手400点体力，自身pp值每恢复一点则吸取效果减少80点，若不存在pp值相等的技能则当回合必定打出致命一击|战斗阶段结束时，若自身若不存在pp值相等的技能，则使自身每个技能的pp值尽可能等于所有技能pp值的平均值，技能pp值总和每因此减少1点，下回合所有技能先制+1，最高+3|（boss无效）

review.rationale: 两版真实魂印分别保留hash及参数；最新回答将均分定义为四舍五入直接设置，各槽按自身上限封顶不再分配，保护与回复封锁均不干预；零总PP仅初始30或40红增。
review.reviewedBy: Codex source, latest user answer and concrete state assertions review
review.singleBehavior: 回初PP重复状态快照与命中恢复后固定理论吸取保留；全不相同触发必暴和战阶末按平均值四舍五入直接分配，每槽封顶，实际总减少对应下回合先制且各版上限3/4；自身总PP0时红伤倍率1.3/1.4。

success.name: 4870全部17招逐实例有序编译与64种子基础，2057/2102两真实版本各17招完整用招，420按已答监听
success.assertion: test('4870全部17招逐实例有序编译与64种子基础，2057/2102两真实版本各17招完整用招，420按已答监听',()=>{for(const m of source.moves){const c=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.compileInstances(m.effectInstances,source.effects,m);assert.equal(c.issue,'');for(const id of[2057,2102]){const h=V(id),a=h.make({move:m.id,soul:true});assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulId,id);assert.equal(E.SOULS.registry[a.fighters[0].soulId].sourceHash,source.souls.find(s=>s.id===id).hash);assert.deepEqual(a.moveDefinitions[key(m.id)].operations.map(x=>[x.effectId,x.index,x.params]),c.operations.map(x=>[x.effectId,x.index,x.params]));turn(a);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.pp,'命中后魂印实际回复当招扣除的1PP');}require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify({...H,source:{...source,moves:[m]}});console.log('# 4870 base verified '+m.id);}assert.deepEqual(require('../local-species.cjs').issues(source),[]);});

success.name: 4870真实2057和2102选择保留各自hash，回初重复PP快照命中后恢复1PP再固定吸取320或360，技能禁疗不阻魂印理论回复
success.assertion: test('4870真实2057和2102选择保留各自hash，回初重复PP快照命中后恢复1PP再固定吸取320或360，技能禁疗不阻魂印理论回复',()=>{for(const [id,n]of[[2057,320],[2102,360]]){const s=V(id).make({move:10234,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000});timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,1000+n);assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed'),n);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.ppSoulEvents2057[0].restored,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.ppSoulEvents2057[0].requestedDrain,n);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.ppFrame2057.sourceHash,source.souls.find(s=>s.id===id).hash);}});

success.name: 4870真实两版恢复每一点PP分别减少80或40，含0槽与溢出，固定免疫不取消理论回复，已命中零红执行而MISS/整招无效/控制不执行
success.assertion: test('4870真实两版恢复每一点PP分别减少80或40，含0槽与溢出，固定免疫不取消理论回复，已命中零红执行而MISS/整招无效/控制不执行',()=>{for(const id of[2057,2102]){const s=V(id).make({move:10234,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000});for(const k of s.fighters[0].moves)s.fighters[0].pp[k]=1;timer(s,1,'固定百分比免疫');turn(s);const n=id===2057?0:200;assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.ppSoulEvents2057[0].restored,5);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,1000+n);assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed'),0);const zero=V(id).make({move:10234,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000});timer(zero,1,'攻击伤害免疫');turn(zero);assert.equal(sum(zero),0);assert.equal(zero.fighters[0].soulState.ppSoulEvents2057.length,1);for(const mode of['miss','invalid','control']){const a=V(id).make({move:10234,index:-1,soul:true,hit:mode!=='miss'});if(mode==='miss')timer(a,0,'攻击必失');if(mode==='invalid')timer(a,0,'skillBlock');if(mode==='control')a.fighters[0].ailments['害怕']=2;turn(a);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulState.ppSoulEvents2057,undefined);}}});

success.name: 4870真实两版回初PP全不相等则当回合必暴，后续扣费造成相等不取消快照；PP倍率30或40依真实总量分档
success.assertion: test('4870真实两版回初PP全不相等则当回合必暴，后续扣费造成相等不取消快照；PP倍率30或40依真实总量分档',()=>{for(const [id,ratio]of[[2057,1.6],[2102,1.8]]){const s=V(id).make({move:10234,index:-1,soul:true,criticals:false});s.fighters[0].moves.forEach((k,i)=>s.fighters[0].pp[k]=[5,4,3,2,1][i]);let crit;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='afterAttack'&&c.a.side===0)crit=c.crit;},()=>turn(s));assert.equal(crit,true);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.ppFrame2057.equalAtStart,false);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.ppSoulEvents2057,undefined);const a=V(id).make({move:10234,index:-1,soul:true});a.fighters[0].moves.forEach((k,i)=>a.fighters[0].pp[k]=[6,1,1,1,1][i]);a.fighters[1].moves.forEach((k,i)=>a.fighters[1].pp[k]=[10,8,5,5,2][i]);let c;observe((e,x)=>{if(e==='beforeDamage'&&x.a.side===0)c=x;},()=>turn(a));assert.equal(c.modifier,ratio);}});

success.name: 4870真实两版整数均值无上限冲突与封锁时精确分配PP且不损总量，非整数四舍五入与每槽上限按已答提交
success.assertion: test('4870真实两版整数均值无上限冲突与封锁时精确分配PP且不损总量，非整数四舍五入与每槽上限按已答提交',()=>{for(const id of[2057,2102]){const s=V(id).make({move:20030,soul:true});s.fighters[0].moves.forEach((k,i)=>s.fighters[0].pp[k]=[5,3,2,1,0][i]);turn(s);assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[0].moves.map(k=>s.fighters[0].pp[k]),[2,2,2,2,2]);const e=s.fighters[0].soulState.ppMeanEvents2057[0];assert.equal(e.totalBefore,10);assert.equal(e.totalAfter,10);assert.equal(e.priority,0);for(const values of[[6,3,2,1,0],[6,4,3,2,1]]){const a=V(id).make({move:20030,soul:true});a.fighters[0].moves.forEach((k,i)=>a.fighters[0].pp[k]=values[i]);const mean=Math.round((values.reduce((n,x)=>n+x,0)-1)/5),expected=a.fighters[0].moves.map(k=>Math.min(mean,a.moveDefinitions[k].pp));turn(a);assert.deepEqual(a.fighters[0].moves.map(k=>a.fighters[0].pp[k]),expected);}}});

success.name: 4870真实两版PP总和0借不受限制用攻或最后1PP扣尽，红增使用初始30%或40%
success.assertion: test('4870真实两版PP总和0借不受限制用攻或最后1PP扣尽，红增使用初始30%或40%',()=>{for(const id of[2057,2102])for(const free of[false,true]){const s=V(id).make({move:10234,index:-1,soul:true});for(const k of s.fighters[0].moves)s.fighters[0].pp[k]=0;if(free)timer(s,0,'不受PP限制');else s.fighters[0].pp[key(10234)]=1;turn(s);assert.ok(sum(s)>0);assert.ok(s.fighters[1].hp<9000);}});

success.name: 4870两真实魂印hash不可互换，未提供版本按源默认选2102，非法选择拒绝
success.assertion: test('4870两真实魂印hash不可互换，未提供版本按源默认选2102，非法选择拒绝',()=>{for(const id of[2057,2102]){const s=structuredClone(source);s.selectedSoulId=id;s.souls.find(x=>x.id===id).hash=source.souls.find(x=>x.id!==id).hash;assert.ok(E.WIKI.assess(s,s.moves.slice(-5).map(m=>m.id)).issues.some(x=>/魂印|版本/.test(x)));}const defaulted=make({soul:true});assert.equal(defaulted.fighters[0].soulId,2102);assert.ok(E.WIKI.assess({...source,selectedSoulId:9999},source.moves.slice(-5).map(m=>m.id)).issues.length>0);});

success.name: 4870已答两魂印PP均分：均值四舍五入各槽封顶余数舍去，直接设定不受保护封锁，实际减少决定下回合先制且各版封顶不同
success.assertion: for(const id of[2057,2102])for(const values of[[7,4,3,2,1],[9,4,3,2,1],[35,5,4,3,2]]){const s=V(id).make({soul:true,move:20030,index:-1});s.fighters[0].moves.forEach((k,i)=>s.fighters[0].pp[k]=values[i]);timer(s,0,'PP保护');timer(s,1,'机械领域');s.fighters[1].soulState.bedPartnerPP=true;const total=values.reduce((n,v)=>n+v,0)-1,mean=Math.round(total/5),expected=s.fighters[0].moves.map(k=>Math.min(mean,s.moveDefinitions[k].pp));observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0){assert.equal(c.ppReductionBlocked(c.a),true);assert.deepEqual(c.restorePP(c.a,1,'skill'),[]);require('../dist/pp-rules.js').protectReduction(c.a,5);}},()=>turn(s));assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[0].moves.map(k=>s.fighters[0].pp[k]),expected);const e=s.fighters[0].soulState.ppMeanEvents2057[0];assert.equal(e.mean,mean);assert.equal(e.priority,Math.min(id===2057?3:4,Math.max(0,total-expected.reduce((n,v)=>n+v,0))));turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,e.priority);}

success.name: 4870已答零分母：两真实魂印最后1PP扣完或全零不受PP限制实际用攻，红增仅初始30%或40%而非无穷
success.assertion: for(const [id,ratio]of[[2057,1.3],[2102,1.4]])for(const free of[false,true]){const s=V(id).make({soul:true,move:10234,index:-1});for(const k of s.fighters[0].moves)s.fighters[0].pp[k]=0;if(free)timer(s,0,'不受PP限制');else s.fighters[0].pp[key(10234)]=1;let actual;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeDamage'&&c.a.side===0)actual=c.modifier;},()=>turn(s));assert.equal(actual,ratio);assert.ok(sum(s)>0);}

failure.name: 4870已答零分母：两真实魂印最后1PP扣完或全零不受PP限制实际用攻，红增仅初始30%或40%而非无穷
failure.assertion: for(const [id,ratio]of[[2057,1.3],[2102,1.4]])for(const free of[false,true]){const s=V(id).make({soul:true,move:10234,index:-1});for(const k of s.fighters[0].moves)s.fighters[0].pp[k]=0;if(free)timer(s,0,'不受PP限制');else s.fighters[0].pp[key(10234)]=1;let actual;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeDamage'&&c.a.side===0)actual=c.modifier;},()=>turn(s));assert.equal(actual,ratio);assert.ok(sum(s)>0);}

boundary.name: 4870全部17招逐实例有序编译与64种子基础，2057/2102两真实版本各17招完整用招，420按已答监听
boundary.assertion: test('4870全部17招逐实例有序编译与64种子基础，2057/2102两真实版本各17招完整用招，420按已答监听',()=>{for(const m of source.moves){const c=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.compileInstances(m.effectInstances,source.effects,m);assert.equal(c.issue,'');for(const id of[2057,2102]){const h=V(id),a=h.make({move:m.id,soul:true});assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulId,id);assert.equal(E.SOULS.registry[a.fighters[0].soulId].sourceHash,source.souls.find(s=>s.id===id).hash);assert.deepEqual(a.moveDefinitions[key(m.id)].operations.map(x=>[x.effectId,x.index,x.params]),c.operations.map(x=>[x.effectId,x.index,x.params]));turn(a);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.pp,'命中后魂印实际回复当招扣除的1PP');}require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify({...H,source:{...source,moves:[m]}});console.log('# 4870 base verified '+m.id);}assert.deepEqual(require('../local-species.cjs').issues(source),[]);});

boundary.name: 4870真实2057和2102选择保留各自hash，回初重复PP快照命中后恢复1PP再固定吸取320或360，技能禁疗不阻魂印理论回复
boundary.assertion: test('4870真实2057和2102选择保留各自hash，回初重复PP快照命中后恢复1PP再固定吸取320或360，技能禁疗不阻魂印理论回复',()=>{for(const [id,n]of[[2057,320],[2102,360]]){const s=V(id).make({move:10234,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000});timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,1000+n);assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed'),n);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.ppSoulEvents2057[0].restored,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.ppSoulEvents2057[0].requestedDrain,n);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.ppFrame2057.sourceHash,source.souls.find(s=>s.id===id).hash);}});

boundary.name: 4870真实两版恢复每一点PP分别减少80或40，含0槽与溢出，固定免疫不取消理论回复，已命中零红执行而MISS/整招无效/控制不执行
boundary.assertion: test('4870真实两版恢复每一点PP分别减少80或40，含0槽与溢出，固定免疫不取消理论回复，已命中零红执行而MISS/整招无效/控制不执行',()=>{for(const id of[2057,2102]){const s=V(id).make({move:10234,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000});for(const k of s.fighters[0].moves)s.fighters[0].pp[k]=1;timer(s,1,'固定百分比免疫');turn(s);const n=id===2057?0:200;assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.ppSoulEvents2057[0].restored,5);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,1000+n);assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed'),0);const zero=V(id).make({move:10234,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000});timer(zero,1,'攻击伤害免疫');turn(zero);assert.equal(sum(zero),0);assert.equal(zero.fighters[0].soulState.ppSoulEvents2057.length,1);for(const mode of['miss','invalid','control']){const a=V(id).make({move:10234,index:-1,soul:true,hit:mode!=='miss'});if(mode==='miss')timer(a,0,'攻击必失');if(mode==='invalid')timer(a,0,'skillBlock');if(mode==='control')a.fighters[0].ailments['害怕']=2;turn(a);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulState.ppSoulEvents2057,undefined);}}});

boundary.name: 4870真实两版回初PP全不相等则当回合必暴，后续扣费造成相等不取消快照；PP倍率30或40依真实总量分档
boundary.assertion: test('4870真实两版回初PP全不相等则当回合必暴，后续扣费造成相等不取消快照；PP倍率30或40依真实总量分档',()=>{for(const [id,ratio]of[[2057,1.6],[2102,1.8]]){const s=V(id).make({move:10234,index:-1,soul:true,criticals:false});s.fighters[0].moves.forEach((k,i)=>s.fighters[0].pp[k]=[5,4,3,2,1][i]);let crit;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='afterAttack'&&c.a.side===0)crit=c.crit;},()=>turn(s));assert.equal(crit,true);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.ppFrame2057.equalAtStart,false);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.ppSoulEvents2057,undefined);const a=V(id).make({move:10234,index:-1,soul:true});a.fighters[0].moves.forEach((k,i)=>a.fighters[0].pp[k]=[6,1,1,1,1][i]);a.fighters[1].moves.forEach((k,i)=>a.fighters[1].pp[k]=[10,8,5,5,2][i]);let c;observe((e,x)=>{if(e==='beforeDamage'&&x.a.side===0)c=x;},()=>turn(a));assert.equal(c.modifier,ratio);}});

boundary.name: 4870真实两版整数均值无上限冲突与封锁时精确分配PP且不损总量，非整数四舍五入与每槽上限按已答提交
boundary.assertion: test('4870真实两版整数均值无上限冲突与封锁时精确分配PP且不损总量，非整数四舍五入与每槽上限按已答提交',()=>{for(const id of[2057,2102]){const s=V(id).make({move:20030,soul:true});s.fighters[0].moves.forEach((k,i)=>s.fighters[0].pp[k]=[5,3,2,1,0][i]);turn(s);assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[0].moves.map(k=>s.fighters[0].pp[k]),[2,2,2,2,2]);const e=s.fighters[0].soulState.ppMeanEvents2057[0];assert.equal(e.totalBefore,10);assert.equal(e.totalAfter,10);assert.equal(e.priority,0);for(const values of[[6,3,2,1,0],[6,4,3,2,1]]){const a=V(id).make({move:20030,soul:true});a.fighters[0].moves.forEach((k,i)=>a.fighters[0].pp[k]=values[i]);const mean=Math.round((values.reduce((n,x)=>n+x,0)-1)/5),expected=a.fighters[0].moves.map(k=>Math.min(mean,a.moveDefinitions[k].pp));turn(a);assert.deepEqual(a.fighters[0].moves.map(k=>a.fighters[0].pp[k]),expected);}}});

interaction.assertion: for(const [id,ratio]of[[2057,1.3],[2102,1.4]])for(const free of[false,true]){const s=V(id).make({soul:true,move:10234,index:-1});for(const k of s.fighters[0].moves)s.fighters[0].pp[k]=0;if(free)timer(s,0,'不受PP限制');else s.fighters[0].pp[key(10234)]=1;let actual;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeDamage'&&c.a.side===0)actual=c.modifier;},()=>turn(s));assert.equal(actual,ratio);assert.ok(sum(s)>0);}

raw.description: 对手pp值总和每比自身高1倍，自身造成的攻击伤害提升40%|回合开始时，若自身存在pp值相等的技能则当回合自身技能命中后恢复所有技能1点pp并吸取对手400点体力，自身pp值每恢复一点则吸取效果减少40点，若不存在pp值相等的技能则当回合必定打出致命一击|战斗阶段结束时，若自身若不存在pp值相等的技能，则使自身每个技能的pp值尽可能等于所有技能pp值的平均值，技能pp值总和每因此减少1点，下回合所有技能先制+1，最高+4|（boss无效）

review.rationale: 两版真实魂印分别保留hash及参数；最新回答将均分定义为四舍五入直接设置，各槽按自身上限封顶不再分配，保护与回复封锁均不干预；零总PP仅初始30或40红增。
review.reviewedBy: Codex source, latest user answer and concrete state assertions review
review.singleBehavior: 回初PP重复状态快照与命中恢复后固定理论吸取保留；全不相同触发必暴和战阶末按平均值四舍五入直接分配，每槽封顶，实际总减少对应下回合先制且各版上限3/4；自身总PP0时红伤倍率1.3/1.4。

success.name: 4870全部17招逐实例有序编译与64种子基础，2057/2102两真实版本各17招完整用招，420按已答监听
success.assertion: test('4870全部17招逐实例有序编译与64种子基础，2057/2102两真实版本各17招完整用招，420按已答监听',()=>{for(const m of source.moves){const c=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.compileInstances(m.effectInstances,source.effects,m);assert.equal(c.issue,'');for(const id of[2057,2102]){const h=V(id),a=h.make({move:m.id,soul:true});assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulId,id);assert.equal(E.SOULS.registry[a.fighters[0].soulId].sourceHash,source.souls.find(s=>s.id===id).hash);assert.deepEqual(a.moveDefinitions[key(m.id)].operations.map(x=>[x.effectId,x.index,x.params]),c.operations.map(x=>[x.effectId,x.index,x.params]));turn(a);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.pp,'命中后魂印实际回复当招扣除的1PP');}require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify({...H,source:{...source,moves:[m]}});console.log('# 4870 base verified '+m.id);}assert.deepEqual(require('../local-species.cjs').issues(source),[]);});

success.name: 4870真实2057和2102选择保留各自hash，回初重复PP快照命中后恢复1PP再固定吸取320或360，技能禁疗不阻魂印理论回复
success.assertion: test('4870真实2057和2102选择保留各自hash，回初重复PP快照命中后恢复1PP再固定吸取320或360，技能禁疗不阻魂印理论回复',()=>{for(const [id,n]of[[2057,320],[2102,360]]){const s=V(id).make({move:10234,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000});timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,1000+n);assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed'),n);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.ppSoulEvents2057[0].restored,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.ppSoulEvents2057[0].requestedDrain,n);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.ppFrame2057.sourceHash,source.souls.find(s=>s.id===id).hash);}});

success.name: 4870真实两版恢复每一点PP分别减少80或40，含0槽与溢出，固定免疫不取消理论回复，已命中零红执行而MISS/整招无效/控制不执行
success.assertion: test('4870真实两版恢复每一点PP分别减少80或40，含0槽与溢出，固定免疫不取消理论回复，已命中零红执行而MISS/整招无效/控制不执行',()=>{for(const id of[2057,2102]){const s=V(id).make({move:10234,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000});for(const k of s.fighters[0].moves)s.fighters[0].pp[k]=1;timer(s,1,'固定百分比免疫');turn(s);const n=id===2057?0:200;assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.ppSoulEvents2057[0].restored,5);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,1000+n);assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed'),0);const zero=V(id).make({move:10234,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000});timer(zero,1,'攻击伤害免疫');turn(zero);assert.equal(sum(zero),0);assert.equal(zero.fighters[0].soulState.ppSoulEvents2057.length,1);for(const mode of['miss','invalid','control']){const a=V(id).make({move:10234,index:-1,soul:true,hit:mode!=='miss'});if(mode==='miss')timer(a,0,'攻击必失');if(mode==='invalid')timer(a,0,'skillBlock');if(mode==='control')a.fighters[0].ailments['害怕']=2;turn(a);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulState.ppSoulEvents2057,undefined);}}});

success.name: 4870真实两版回初PP全不相等则当回合必暴，后续扣费造成相等不取消快照；PP倍率30或40依真实总量分档
success.assertion: test('4870真实两版回初PP全不相等则当回合必暴，后续扣费造成相等不取消快照；PP倍率30或40依真实总量分档',()=>{for(const [id,ratio]of[[2057,1.6],[2102,1.8]]){const s=V(id).make({move:10234,index:-1,soul:true,criticals:false});s.fighters[0].moves.forEach((k,i)=>s.fighters[0].pp[k]=[5,4,3,2,1][i]);let crit;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='afterAttack'&&c.a.side===0)crit=c.crit;},()=>turn(s));assert.equal(crit,true);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.ppFrame2057.equalAtStart,false);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.ppSoulEvents2057,undefined);const a=V(id).make({move:10234,index:-1,soul:true});a.fighters[0].moves.forEach((k,i)=>a.fighters[0].pp[k]=[6,1,1,1,1][i]);a.fighters[1].moves.forEach((k,i)=>a.fighters[1].pp[k]=[10,8,5,5,2][i]);let c;observe((e,x)=>{if(e==='beforeDamage'&&x.a.side===0)c=x;},()=>turn(a));assert.equal(c.modifier,ratio);}});

interaction.assertion: for(const id of[2057,2102])for(const values of[[7,4,3,2,1],[9,4,3,2,1],[35,5,4,3,2]]){const s=V(id).make({soul:true,move:20030,index:-1});s.fighters[0].moves.forEach((k,i)=>s.fighters[0].pp[k]=values[i]);timer(s,0,'PP保护');timer(s,1,'机械领域');s.fighters[1].soulState.bedPartnerPP=true;const total=values.reduce((n,v)=>n+v,0)-1,mean=Math.round(total/5),expected=s.fighters[0].moves.map(k=>Math.min(mean,s.moveDefinitions[k].pp));observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0){assert.equal(c.ppReductionBlocked(c.a),true);assert.deepEqual(c.restorePP(c.a,1,'skill'),[]);require('../dist/pp-rules.js').protectReduction(c.a,5);}},()=>turn(s));assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[0].moves.map(k=>s.fighters[0].pp[k]),expected);const e=s.fighters[0].soulState.ppMeanEvents2057[0];assert.equal(e.mean,mean);assert.equal(e.priority,Math.min(id===2057?3:4,Math.max(0,total-expected.reduce((n,v)=>n+v,0))));turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,e.priority);}

interaction.assertion: for(const [id,ratio]of[[2057,1.3],[2102,1.4]])for(const free of[false,true]){const s=V(id).make({soul:true,move:10234,index:-1});for(const k of s.fighters[0].moves)s.fighters[0].pp[k]=0;if(free)timer(s,0,'不受PP限制');else s.fighters[0].pp[key(10234)]=1;let actual;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeDamage'&&c.a.side===0)actual=c.modifier;},()=>turn(s));assert.equal(actual,ratio);assert.ok(sum(s)>0);}

success.assertion: test('4870/2严格低于半体威力翻倍、191四回合反弹优先次数免异、843下两回合先制2、4和5重复实例按真实参数概率变化',()=>{for(const hp of[4499,4500]){const s=make({...row(2),targetHp:hp});let c;observe((e,x)=>{if(e==='beforeDamage'&&x.a.side===0)c=x;},()=>turn(s));assert.equal(c.power,hp<4500?120:60);}const reflect=make(row(191));turn(reflect);reflect.fighters[0].counts.immune=2;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){assert.equal(c.ailment(c.t,'中毒',c.a,false,false,2),false);assert.ok(c.a.ailments['中毒']);assert.equal(c.t.counts.immune,2);}},()=>turn(reflect));const p=make(row(843));turn(p);p.moveDefinitions[key(38268)].operations=[];for(const n of[2,2,0]){turn(p,38268);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,n);}for(const m of source.moves)for(let index=0;index<m.effectInstances.length;index++){const e=m.effectInstances[index];if(![4,5].includes(e.id))continue;const seen=new Set();for(let seed=1;seed<=(e.args[1]===100?1:32);seed++){const s=make({move:m.id,index,seed:Math.imul(seed,0x9e3779b1)>>>0});turn(s);const side=e.id===4?0:1;seen.add(s.fighters[side].stages[keys[e.args[0]]]);}assert.ok(seen.has(e.args[2]));if(e.args[1]<100)assert.ok(seen.has(0));}});

success.assertion: test('4870全部17招逐实例有序编译与64种子基础，2057/2102两真实版本各17招完整用招，420按已答监听',()=>{for(const m of source.moves){const c=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.compileInstances(m.effectInstances,source.effects,m);assert.equal(c.issue,'');for(const id of[2057,2102]){const h=V(id),a=h.make({move:m.id,soul:true});assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulId,id);assert.equal(E.SOULS.registry[a.fighters[0].soulId].sourceHash,source.souls.find(s=>s.id===id).hash);assert.deepEqual(a.moveDefinitions[key(m.id)].operations.map(x=>[x.effectId,x.index,x.params]),c.operations.map(x=>[x.effectId,x.index,x.params]));turn(a);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.pp,'命中后魂印实际回复当招扣除的1PP');}require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify({...H,source:{...source,moves:[m]}});console.log('# 4870 base verified '+m.id);}assert.deepEqual(require('../local-species.cjs').issues(source),[]);});

success.assertion: test('4870/1863真实基础10段及扣费前每个不满PP槽加1，不误把本次新扣费算入；1930每级先制加1段封顶4',()=>{for(const deficient of[0,2,5]){const s=make(row(1863));s.fighters[0].moves.slice(0,deficient).forEach(k=>s.fighters[0].pp[k]--);turn(s);assert.equal((s.damageEvents??[]).filter(e=>e.type==='attack'&&e.sourceSide===0).length,10+deficient);}for(const n of[0,1,2,5]){const s=make(row(1930));if(n)timer(s,0,'id984',{amount:n});turn(s);assert.equal((s.damageEvents??[]).filter(e=>e.type==='attack'&&e.sourceSide===0).length,Math.min(4,2+n));}});

success.assertion: test('4870/1323同e9360ed4完整结算红伤50%回复，暴击按净回复附粉，过量低HP仍按完整红伤回血，满血与技能禁疗无净回复附粉',()=>{for(const [hp,crit,ban]of[[1000,false,false],[1000,true,false],[8999,true,false],[9000,true,false],[1000,true,true]]){const s=make({...row(1323),hp});if(crit)timer(s,0,'必定暴击');if(ban)timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');turn(s);const n=ban?0:Math.min(9000-hp,Math.floor(sum(s)*.5));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,hp+n);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),crit?n:0);}const low=make({...row(1323),hp:1000,targetHp:1});turn(low);assert.ok(sum(low)>1);assert.equal(low.fighters[0].hp,1000+Math.floor(sum(low)*.5));});

boundary.name: 4870/2严格低于半体威力翻倍、191四回合反弹优先次数免异、843下两回合先制2、4和5重复实例按真实参数概率变化
boundary.assertion: test('4870/2严格低于半体威力翻倍、191四回合反弹优先次数免异、843下两回合先制2、4和5重复实例按真实参数概率变化',()=>{for(const hp of[4499,4500]){const s=make({...row(2),targetHp:hp});let c;observe((e,x)=>{if(e==='beforeDamage'&&x.a.side===0)c=x;},()=>turn(s));assert.equal(c.power,hp<4500?120:60);}const reflect=make(row(191));turn(reflect);reflect.fighters[0].counts.immune=2;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){assert.equal(c.ailment(c.t,'中毒',c.a,false,false,2),false);assert.ok(c.a.ailments['中毒']);assert.equal(c.t.counts.immune,2);}},()=>turn(reflect));const p=make(row(843));turn(p);p.moveDefinitions[key(38268)].operations=[];for(const n of[2,2,0]){turn(p,38268);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,n);}for(const m of source.moves)for(let index=0;index<m.effectInstances.length;index++){const e=m.effectInstances[index];if(![4,5].includes(e.id))continue;const seen=new Set();for(let seed=1;seed<=(e.args[1]===100?1:32);seed++){const s=make({move:m.id,index,seed:Math.imul(seed,0x9e3779b1)>>>0});turn(s);const side=e.id===4?0:1;seen.add(s.fighters[side].stages[keys[e.args[0]]]);}assert.ok(seen.has(e.args[2]));if(e.args[1]<100)assert.ok(seen.has(0));}});

success.assertion: test('4870/1037清强成功授下1次50%红增，保护失败不授；723后手才使敌下两回合先制-1；402后手附50固定',()=>{const a=make(row(1037)),base=make({move:38267,index:-1});a.fighters[1].stages.def=2;turn(a);turn(base);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].counts.nextAttackBoost,1);for(const s of[a,base]){s.moveDefinitions[key(34017)].operations=[];s.rng=0x9e3779b9;turn(s,34017);}assert.ok(sum(a)>=Math.floor(sum(base)*1.5));assert.ok(sum(a)<Math.ceil((sum(base)+1)*1.5));const p=make(row(1037));p.fighters[1].stages.def=2;timer(p,1,'强化保护');turn(p);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].counts.nextAttackBoost??0,0);for(const late of[false,true]){const s=make({...row(723),aStats:{spe:late?1:500}});turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].effects.id984?.amount??0,late?-1:0);if(late){assert.equal(s.fighters[1].effects.id984.start,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].effects.id984.end,3);}const f=make({...row(402),aStats:{spe:late?1:500}});turn(f);assert.equal(sum(f,'fixed'),late?50:0);}});

success.assertion: test('4870全部17招逐实例有序编译与64种子基础，2057/2102两真实版本各17招完整用招，420按已答监听',()=>{for(const m of source.moves){const c=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.compileInstances(m.effectInstances,source.effects,m);assert.equal(c.issue,'');for(const id of[2057,2102]){const h=V(id),a=h.make({move:m.id,soul:true});assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulId,id);assert.equal(E.SOULS.registry[a.fighters[0].soulId].sourceHash,source.souls.find(s=>s.id===id).hash);assert.deepEqual(a.moveDefinitions[key(m.id)].operations.map(x=>[x.effectId,x.index,x.params]),c.operations.map(x=>[x.effectId,x.index,x.params]));turn(a);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.pp,'命中后魂印实际回复当招扣除的1PP');}require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify({...H,source:{...source,moves:[m]}});console.log('# 4870 base verified '+m.id);}assert.deepEqual(require('../local-species.cjs').issues(source),[]);});

success.name: 4870/2严格低于半体威力翻倍、191四回合反弹优先次数免异、843下两回合先制2、4和5重复实例按真实参数概率变化
success.assertion: test('4870/2严格低于半体威力翻倍、191四回合反弹优先次数免异、843下两回合先制2、4和5重复实例按真实参数概率变化',()=>{for(const hp of[4499,4500]){const s=make({...row(2),targetHp:hp});let c;observe((e,x)=>{if(e==='beforeDamage'&&x.a.side===0)c=x;},()=>turn(s));assert.equal(c.power,hp<4500?120:60);}const reflect=make(row(191));turn(reflect);reflect.fighters[0].counts.immune=2;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){assert.equal(c.ailment(c.t,'中毒',c.a,false,false,2),false);assert.ok(c.a.ailments['中毒']);assert.equal(c.t.counts.immune,2);}},()=>turn(reflect));const p=make(row(843));turn(p);p.moveDefinitions[key(38268)].operations=[];for(const n of[2,2,0]){turn(p,38268);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,n);}for(const m of source.moves)for(let index=0;index<m.effectInstances.length;index++){const e=m.effectInstances[index];if(![4,5].includes(e.id))continue;const seen=new Set();for(let seed=1;seed<=(e.args[1]===100?1:32);seed++){const s=make({move:m.id,index,seed:Math.imul(seed,0x9e3779b1)>>>0});turn(s);const side=e.id===4?0:1;seen.add(s.fighters[side].stages[keys[e.args[0]]]);}assert.ok(seen.has(e.args[2]));if(e.args[1]<100)assert.ok(seen.has(0));}});

success.assertion: test('4870/1863真实基础10段及扣费前每个不满PP槽加1，不误把本次新扣费算入；1930每级先制加1段封顶4',()=>{for(const deficient of[0,2,5]){const s=make(row(1863));s.fighters[0].moves.slice(0,deficient).forEach(k=>s.fighters[0].pp[k]--);turn(s);assert.equal((s.damageEvents??[]).filter(e=>e.type==='attack'&&e.sourceSide===0).length,10+deficient);}for(const n of[0,1,2,5]){const s=make(row(1930));if(n)timer(s,0,'id984',{amount:n});turn(s);assert.equal((s.damageEvents??[]).filter(e=>e.type==='attack'&&e.sourceSide===0).length,Math.min(4,2+n));}});

success.name: 4870/1323同e9360ed4完整结算红伤50%回复，暴击按净回复附粉，过量低HP仍按完整红伤回血，满血与技能禁疗无净回复附粉
success.assertion: test('4870/1323同e9360ed4完整结算红伤50%回复，暴击按净回复附粉，过量低HP仍按完整红伤回血，满血与技能禁疗无净回复附粉',()=>{for(const [hp,crit,ban]of[[1000,false,false],[1000,true,false],[8999,true,false],[9000,true,false],[1000,true,true]]){const s=make({...row(1323),hp});if(crit)timer(s,0,'必定暴击');if(ban)timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');turn(s);const n=ban?0:Math.min(9000-hp,Math.floor(sum(s)*.5));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,hp+n);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),crit?n:0);}const low=make({...row(1323),hp:1000,targetHp:1});turn(low);assert.ok(sum(low)>1);assert.equal(low.fighters[0].hp,1000+Math.floor(sum(low)*.5));});

success.name: 4870/2严格低于半体威力翻倍、191四回合反弹优先次数免异、843下两回合先制2、4和5重复实例按真实参数概率变化
success.assertion: test('4870/2严格低于半体威力翻倍、191四回合反弹优先次数免异、843下两回合先制2、4和5重复实例按真实参数概率变化',()=>{for(const hp of[4499,4500]){const s=make({...row(2),targetHp:hp});let c;observe((e,x)=>{if(e==='beforeDamage'&&x.a.side===0)c=x;},()=>turn(s));assert.equal(c.power,hp<4500?120:60);}const reflect=make(row(191));turn(reflect);reflect.fighters[0].counts.immune=2;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){assert.equal(c.ailment(c.t,'中毒',c.a,false,false,2),false);assert.ok(c.a.ailments['中毒']);assert.equal(c.t.counts.immune,2);}},()=>turn(reflect));const p=make(row(843));turn(p);p.moveDefinitions[key(38268)].operations=[];for(const n of[2,2,0]){turn(p,38268);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,n);}for(const m of source.moves)for(let index=0;index<m.effectInstances.length;index++){const e=m.effectInstances[index];if(![4,5].includes(e.id))continue;const seen=new Set();for(let seed=1;seed<=(e.args[1]===100?1:32);seed++){const s=make({move:m.id,index,seed:Math.imul(seed,0x9e3779b1)>>>0});turn(s);const side=e.id===4?0:1;seen.add(s.fighters[side].stages[keys[e.args[0]]]);}assert.ok(seen.has(e.args[2]));if(e.args[1]<100)assert.ok(seen.has(0));}});

raw.description: 技能使用成功时，100%改变自身防御等级+2；技能使用成功时，100%改变自身特防等级+2；使用了该技能后，若受到消除强化类技能攻击，则对方攻击和特攻等级-1

metadata.template: 使用了该技能后，若受到消除强化类技能攻击，则对方攻击和特攻等级{0}

review.rationale: 最新回答精确限定清强成功的已命中攻击，吸强与反转不属于该分类；先手当回合、后手至下回合，同源刷新。
review.reviewedBy: Codex source, latest user answer and concrete state assertions review
review.singleBehavior: 授清强反制监听；已命中攻击实际清除自身正等级后令敌双攻-1，次数按真实用招去重；不要求正红，无强化/保护失败/MISS、吸强、反转不触发；双攻下降遵守免弱。

success.name: 4870全部17招逐实例有序编译与64种子基础，2057/2102两真实版本各17招完整用招，420按已答监听
success.assertion: test('4870全部17招逐实例有序编译与64种子基础，2057/2102两真实版本各17招完整用招，420按已答监听',()=>{for(const m of source.moves){const c=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.compileInstances(m.effectInstances,source.effects,m);assert.equal(c.issue,'');for(const id of[2057,2102]){const h=V(id),a=h.make({move:m.id,soul:true});assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulId,id);assert.equal(E.SOULS.registry[a.fighters[0].soulId].sourceHash,source.souls.find(s=>s.id===id).hash);assert.deepEqual(a.moveDefinitions[key(m.id)].operations.map(x=>[x.effectId,x.index,x.params]),c.operations.map(x=>[x.effectId,x.index,x.params]));turn(a);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.pp,'命中后魂印实际回复当招扣除的1PP');}require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify({...H,source:{...source,moves:[m]}});console.log('# 4870 base verified '+m.id);}assert.deepEqual(require('../local-species.cjs').issues(source),[]);});

success.name: 4870已答420：先手当回合后手多一回合，同源刷新，命中且清强成功才降双攻，零红正常清强触发，MISS/保护/无强化不触发
success.assertion:
for(const fast of[false,true])for(const mode of['normal','zero','miss','protect','no-boost']){const s=counter({aStats:{spe:fast?500:1},hit:mode!=='miss'});if(mode==='zero')timer(s,0,'攻击伤害免疫');if(mode==='miss')timer(s,1,'攻击必失');if(mode==='protect')timer(s,0,'强化保护');if(mode==='no-boost')s.fighters[0].stages.def=0;turn(s,21822,16074);const expected=fast&&['normal','zero'].includes(mode)?-1:0;assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.atk,expected,fast+':'+mode);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.spa,expected);const effect=s.fighters[0].effects['岩石之躯清强反制'];if(fast)assert.equal(effect,undefined,'先手本回合监听已到期');else assert.equal(effect.end,2);if(!fast){s.fighters[0].stages.def=2;s.fighters[1].effects={};s.fighters[0].effects['强化保护']&&delete s.fighters[0].effects['强化保护'];const next=+s.fighters[0].moves.find(k=>['physical','special'].includes(s.moveDefinitions[k].kind)).split(':')[1];s.moveDefinitions[key(next)].operations=[];turn(s,next,16074);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.atk,-1);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.spa,-1);}}
 const s=counter({aStats:{spe:1}});turn(s,21822,10001);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].effects['岩石之躯清强反制'].end,2);turn(s,21822,10001);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].effects['岩石之躯清强反制'].end,3);s.fighters[0].stages.def=2;const next=+s.fighters[0].moves.find(k=>['physical','special'].includes(s.moveDefinitions[k].kind)).split(':')[1];s.moveDefinitions[key(next)].operations=[];turn(s,next,16074);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.spa,-1);s.fighters[0].stages.def=2;turn(s,next,16074);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.spa,-1);

success.assertion: test('4870/2严格低于半体威力翻倍、191四回合反弹优先次数免异、843下两回合先制2、4和5重复实例按真实参数概率变化',()=>{for(const hp of[4499,4500]){const s=make({...row(2),targetHp:hp});let c;observe((e,x)=>{if(e==='beforeDamage'&&x.a.side===0)c=x;},()=>turn(s));assert.equal(c.power,hp<4500?120:60);}const reflect=make(row(191));turn(reflect);reflect.fighters[0].counts.immune=2;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){assert.equal(c.ailment(c.t,'中毒',c.a,false,false,2),false);assert.ok(c.a.ailments['中毒']);assert.equal(c.t.counts.immune,2);}},()=>turn(reflect));const p=make(row(843));turn(p);p.moveDefinitions[key(38268)].operations=[];for(const n of[2,2,0]){turn(p,38268);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,n);}for(const m of source.moves)for(let index=0;index<m.effectInstances.length;index++){const e=m.effectInstances[index];if(![4,5].includes(e.id))continue;const seen=new Set();for(let seed=1;seed<=(e.args[1]===100?1:32);seed++){const s=make({move:m.id,index,seed:Math.imul(seed,0x9e3779b1)>>>0});turn(s);const side=e.id===4?0:1;seen.add(s.fighters[side].stages[keys[e.args[0]]]);}assert.ok(seen.has(e.args[2]));if(e.args[1]<100)assert.ok(seen.has(0));}});

success.assertion: test('4870全部17招逐实例有序编译与64种子基础，2057/2102两真实版本各17招完整用招，420按已答监听',()=>{for(const m of source.moves){const c=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.compileInstances(m.effectInstances,source.effects,m);assert.equal(c.issue,'');for(const id of[2057,2102]){const h=V(id),a=h.make({move:m.id,soul:true});assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulId,id);assert.equal(E.SOULS.registry[a.fighters[0].soulId].sourceHash,source.souls.find(s=>s.id===id).hash);assert.deepEqual(a.moveDefinitions[key(m.id)].operations.map(x=>[x.effectId,x.index,x.params]),c.operations.map(x=>[x.effectId,x.index,x.params]));turn(a);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.pp,'命中后魂印实际回复当招扣除的1PP');}require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify({...H,source:{...source,moves:[m]}});console.log('# 4870 base verified '+m.id);}assert.deepEqual(require('../local-species.cjs').issues(source),[]);});

success.assertion: test('4870/1037清强成功授下1次50%红增，保护失败不授；723后手才使敌下两回合先制-1；402后手附50固定',()=>{const a=make(row(1037)),base=make({move:38267,index:-1});a.fighters[1].stages.def=2;turn(a);turn(base);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].counts.nextAttackBoost,1);for(const s of[a,base]){s.moveDefinitions[key(34017)].operations=[];s.rng=0x9e3779b9;turn(s,34017);}assert.ok(sum(a)>=Math.floor(sum(base)*1.5));assert.ok(sum(a)<Math.ceil((sum(base)+1)*1.5));const p=make(row(1037));p.fighters[1].stages.def=2;timer(p,1,'强化保护');turn(p);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].counts.nextAttackBoost??0,0);for(const late of[false,true]){const s=make({...row(723),aStats:{spe:late?1:500}});turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].effects.id984?.amount??0,late?-1:0);if(late){assert.equal(s.fighters[1].effects.id984.start,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].effects.id984.end,3);}const f=make({...row(402),aStats:{spe:late?1:500}});turn(f);assert.equal(sum(f,'fixed'),late?50:0);}});

success.assertion: test('4870/2严格低于半体威力翻倍、191四回合反弹优先次数免异、843下两回合先制2、4和5重复实例按真实参数概率变化',()=>{for(const hp of[4499,4500]){const s=make({...row(2),targetHp:hp});let c;observe((e,x)=>{if(e==='beforeDamage'&&x.a.side===0)c=x;},()=>turn(s));assert.equal(c.power,hp<4500?120:60);}const reflect=make(row(191));turn(reflect);reflect.fighters[0].counts.immune=2;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){assert.equal(c.ailment(c.t,'中毒',c.a,false,false,2),false);assert.ok(c.a.ailments['中毒']);assert.equal(c.t.counts.immune,2);}},()=>turn(reflect));const p=make(row(843));turn(p);p.moveDefinitions[key(38268)].operations=[];for(const n of[2,2,0]){turn(p,38268);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,n);}for(const m of source.moves)for(let index=0;index<m.effectInstances.length;index++){const e=m.effectInstances[index];if(![4,5].includes(e.id))continue;const seen=new Set();for(let seed=1;seed<=(e.args[1]===100?1:32);seed++){const s=make({move:m.id,index,seed:Math.imul(seed,0x9e3779b1)>>>0});turn(s);const side=e.id===4?0:1;seen.add(s.fighters[side].stages[keys[e.args[0]]]);}assert.ok(seen.has(e.args[2]));if(e.args[1]<100)assert.ok(seen.has(0));}});

success.assertion: test('4870/942清回合成功吸取最大HP三分一，保护或无回合失败不吸取，低HP过量按理论3000回复且技能禁疗只挡技能回血',()=>{for(const mode of['success','protected','none','overkill','ban']){const s=make({move:38269,index:1,hp:1000,targetHp:mode==='overkill'?200:9000});if(mode==='protected')timer(s,1,'protect');if(mode==='none')s.fighters[1].effects={};if(mode==='ban')timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');turn(s);const success=!['protected','none'].includes(mode);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),success?3000:0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,success&&mode!=='ban'?4000:1000);if(mode==='overkill'){assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,0);const event=s.damageEvents.find(e=>e.type==='percent');assert.equal(event.settledDamage,3000);assert.ok(event.hpLoss<3000);}}});

success.assertion: test('4870/1323同e9360ed4完整结算红伤50%回复，暴击按净回复附粉，过量低HP仍按完整红伤回血，满血与技能禁疗无净回复附粉',()=>{for(const [hp,crit,ban]of[[1000,false,false],[1000,true,false],[8999,true,false],[9000,true,false],[1000,true,true]]){const s=make({...row(1323),hp});if(crit)timer(s,0,'必定暴击');if(ban)timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');turn(s);const n=ban?0:Math.min(9000-hp,Math.floor(sum(s)*.5));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,hp+n);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),crit?n:0);}const low=make({...row(1323),hp:1000,targetHp:1});turn(low);assert.ok(sum(low)>1);assert.equal(low.fighters[0].hp,1000+Math.floor(sum(low)*.5));});

instance.description: 当回合击败对手则恢复自身所有技能PP值

raw.description: 自身每有1级先制则连击次数+1，最高连击4次；消除对手回合类效果，消除成功则吸取对手最大体力的1/3；造成伤害的50%恢复自身体力，若打出致命一击则附加恢复体力值等量的百分比伤害；当回合击败对手则恢复自身所有技能PP值

metadata.template: 当回合击败对手则恢复自身所有技能PP值

review.rationale: 两版魂印和17招当前双方效果均完整保留逐条单精灵审核，不以PP歧义报错替代已答行为。
review.reviewedBy: Codex source, latest user answer and concrete state assertions review
review.singleBehavior: 当回合击败对手则恢复自身所有技能PP值

success.name: 4870/1286当回合实际击败恢复全PP，未击败不回；1020敌无强全强翻倍，3解除自身弱化遵守保护
success.assertion: test('4870/1286当回合实际击败恢复全PP，未击败不回；1020敌无强全强翻倍，3解除自身弱化遵守保护',()=>{for(const killed of[false,true]){const s=make({...row(1286),targetHp:killed?1:9000});for(const k of s.fighters[0].moves)s.fighters[0].pp[k]=k===key(38269)?1:0;turn(s);for(const k of s.fighters[0].moves)assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[k],killed?s.moveDefinitions[k].pp:0);}for(const positive of[false,true]){const s=make(row(1020));if(positive)s.fighters[1].stages.def=1;turn(s);for(const k of keys)assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages[k],positive?1:2);}for(const protectedCase of[false,true]){const s=make(row(3));s.fighters[0].stages.def=-2;if(protectedCase)timer(s,0,'弱化不可解除反转');turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.def,protectedCase?-2:0);}});
